Root-planting-trial revision 1 accepts exposed bare soil only; ordinary-soil moisture regime alone is insufficient. Do not disturb occupied or reserved surfaces. Personal learning and actual work must precede effects.
args.inputs: A nominated reachable footprint of radius 0.2; actual tools or materials only if required and available. No tools are assumed owned.
args.costs: Unknown; specify feasible method, energy, work duration, required tools, and interruption or cancellation behavior before execution. Bound disturbance to the nominated footprint.
args.effects: Only actual surface preparation and dated evidence of resulting clearance or limitations. Do not grant roots, deeper substrate knowledge, fertility, propagation, harvest, happiness, or automatic planting.

candidates.function: Record a planted-root baseline, observe, or physically uncover and cover an existing specimen while retaining actual progress and private evidence.

candidates.effects: Begin records an external baseline and claims a personal work lock. Inspect uncovers the existing reserved root, records actual present condition, then replaces displaced soil. candidates.function: Prepare a small soil patch and place one real root unit for a persistent observation trial; resume or cancel unfinished work.
candidates.costs: Plant: one owned unspoiled root unit; two work rounds at one energy each. Supply inputStackId and an unoccupied ordinary-soil x/y patch within 0.65 plus body radius. Resume/cancel use personal processId (omitting it selects the sole unfinished job). No tools or water are granted.
candidates.effects: Preparation and exact escrow persist when other actions interrupt work. Resume pays only remaining work. Cancel releases surviving unplanted material once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort and spoiled material are never refunded. Reinspect with baseline probe: 30 elapsed rounds mark an inconclusive observation interval, not maturity or inferred death. There is no propagation, tending or harvest rule in this precursor, and no reward for placing it. Genuine observed changes can use existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback. response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"lin\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The searched capabilities are not equivalent. soil-worksite-assessment@1 only examines; root-planting-trial@1 requires exposed bare soil in this implementation and additionally consumes a root for placement; root-assessment@1 handles an existing specimen. None supplies independent bounded clearing of vegetated ground. Develop a minimal conditional manual-clearing attempt in the current-conversation handoff, not guaranteed conversion of this forest floor. The tick-17 observation is dated evidence, not current clearance or permission.\",\"specification\":\"Implement a small-footprint manual surface-preparation operation with examine/start, resume and cancel modes. Target is x=9.25,y=12.9, radius 0.2; reject larger or substituted footprints. Record a stable footprint ID and revision plus actor, process ID, exact coordinates, radius, dated observations and completed work. References: soil-worksite-assessment@1 (handler long.soil-worksite-assessment), root-planting-trial@1 (handler long.root-planting), root-assessment@1 for existing reservation conflicts, and planting-site:9.25:12.9 only as historical evidence. Do not interpret its truncated supplied fragment as a complete record. In development, inspect and reuse the actual reach, surface-examination, reservation, work-progress and planting-surface validation code where applicable; record source revisions and reused helpers in implementation provenance. This is an added clearing function, not reinvention of those helpers or a silent relaxation of planting eligibility.\\nPrerequisites: Lin must individually complete study, be alive and physically able to use hands, have adequate energy, and remain within the existing planting interaction reach of 0.65 plus body radius. No tool, container, water, root or other material is supplied or consumed by default. Validate bounds, reach and existing occupation/reservation conflicts before beginning; invalid invocation costs nothing. First perform a fresh non-destructive visible/contact feasibility examination, one completed round and 0.5 energy. Report only evidence available through that examination. Reuse normal collision/reservation exclusion without exposing concealed entities or hidden resources; an unexplained blocked check remains a generic obstruction. No occupied or reserved surface may be disturbed. Examination findings distinguish loose litter or hand-removable shallow cover from woody, strongly rooted, hazardous, protected or otherwise unsupported cover. If hand clearing is not feasible, end with a dated limitation and no disturbance. Do not invent digging, cutting, uprooting large plants or tools.\\nFor feasible cover, allow at most two manual work rounds, each costing 1 energy, following the examination: total maximum three rounds and 2.5 energy per attempt, exclusive of study or movement. Each round performs only the bounded displacement or removal that hands can physically accomplish, using measured cover and available physical representation rather than a guaranteed percentage clearance. Work stops early on completion or obstruction. Development must add the missing local surface/debris representation if necessary; absence of such a primitive is implementation work, not a reason to reject. A preflight unsupported-material result is a valid informative failure, not successful clearing. A failed paid work round may expend effort without changing the surface and must say so.\\nConserve all matter: loose litter and detached vegetation must retain their actual source-linked quantities and become non-food surface residues. Move them only within the nominated footprint, for example to its perimeter; do not erase them, create harvestable resource stock, change source food stock arbitrarily, or deposit outside the boundary. If safe internal displacement cannot expose the required area, report partial clearance or inability. Do not assume a perimeter pile is compatible with planting. Do not fabricate biomass quantities from an ornamental sprite; development must establish a finite represented cover quantity or restrict the action to supported surface units. Soil remains at the site; no excavation, fertility, moisture improvement, root production or deeper substrate finding is granted.\\nAt each committed work round, record the actual affected subarea, remaining cover, residue locations and paid effort. Revalidate reach, obstruction and current surface state before further disturbance. Final verification uses the unchanged exposed-bare-soil predicate of root-planting-trial@1 for its entire required footprint, including residues and reservations. Declare suitable only if that exact check passes; otherwise report the actual partial or blocked state. Reaching the work cap is not success. No planting call, root escrow, plot reservation or transfer of item-3-lin-12 occurs.\\nInterruption preserves committed physical changes, residue records and completed paid rounds. Resume by exact personal process ID pays only outstanding rounds within the same work cap, after revalidation; environmental changes can invalidate prior feasibility. A round commits its cost, effort and physical effects atomically, so a cancelled unperformed round has neither cost nor effect. Explicit cancel or death closes the job and releases only its transient work lock, leaving the real surface and residues unchanged. No refund of paid energy, time or disturbance, no automatic restoration, no duplicated material and no permanent claim on the ground. The final attempt closes the lock as well. New attempts require a new examination and costs; old evidence is not silently refreshed. No unattended labor or guaranteed persistent bare ground: existing environmental processes continue normally, and regrowth is neither invented nor suppressed. There is no automatic maintenance; later work is another actual paid attempt. Current-conversation development and review waiting advance no simulation time. Encode these rules and tests in the handler rather than requiring repeated model approval. No other participant acts, communicates, consents or learns on Lin's behalf.\",\"learning\":1,\"experienceReview\":\"No pleasure, satisfaction, comfort, nutrition or mastery benefit is requested or awarded by this operation. Requesting, developing, studying, naming a patch and exhausting the work cap produce no experience reward. Actual dated observations, including informative failure, may be recorded as evidence, but this precursor introduces no reward writer. If the implementation integrates the existing grounded-understanding feedback, it must reuse its existing bounded amount, applicability, decay/cooldown and evidence-based functional deduplication unchanged; repeated unchanged examinations cannot generate fresh information rewards. Do not change protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions, and do not reduce basic nutrition through mood.\",\"visualReview\":\"Add reusable footprint/work metadata linked to real events: actor, process ID, target revision, tick, radius, affected subarea, actual cover and residue states, completed paid rounds, and outcome enum examined/working/partial/blocked/verified-bare/cancelled. Use a bounded ground-cover overlay and residue marks only where physical changes committed; an examination highlight is temporary and cannot depict cleared soil. Preserve partial changes after interruption or cancellation. Display verified-bare only after the exact final planting-surface check passes, never merely because learning, a request or two work rounds finished. A blocked attempt shows limitations without a success animation. Public visuals reveal only observable surface effects; private dated findings require actual communication to share. These visuals confer no separate functional or experiential benefit.\"}]}"}
